f about 6–9. At high A (around 3.6) it peaks near t ≈ 2 and then declines. A purely additive model in log(1+t)^2 and powers of A does not capture this, which is why every simple family I tried stayed well above 1e-4.

I ran out of tool calls before finding the right interaction term between A and t.

def equation(t, A, params):
    return params[0]*np.log(1+t)**2 + params[1]*A**params[2]*t*np.exp(-params[3]*t) + params[4]*A**params[5] + params[6]*A**params[7]*np.log(1+params[8]*t)
